text:
You need an automation system where users upload a file to their profile and the website shares that document across multiple sites.

I’m Noor Halden, and I have 6 years of experience building Python-based AI and machine learning solutions. For Strata Engineering Group, I built an on-premise private wiki question answering system over 14k pages of engineering standards using Python, LlamaIndex, Qdrant, Ollama, Llama 3, and FastAPI. It achieved an 82% top-3 hit rate on 60 engineer questions, with zero external API calls.

For your AI automation website, I can help design the file-upload and distribution workflow, and implement the automation logic in a reliable way using Python and related web tooling. I’m comfortable working with scripting, NLP, and automation tasks.

Do you already have the target sites and posting flow defined, or should the automation be designed to handle that mapping as well?
